    Universal Compatibility

    Works With Any AI Tool.

    One install. One setup command. lean-ctx adds a context layer to every AI tool that uses MCP — and even those that don't benefit from shell hook intelligence.

    No MCP? No problem.

    Shell Hook Only

    Tools that don't support MCP still benefit from lean-ctx. The shell hook intercepts CLI commands (git, npm, cargo, docker, kubectl, and 90+ more) and compresses their output before the AI sees it.

    OpenClawAny CLI-based AI tool
    Shell Hook

    Intercepts git, npm, cargo, docker, kubectl, pip, go, tsc, and 80+ more commands. Compresses output by 60–90%.

    MCP Server

    49 specialized tools: ctx_read, ctx_search, ctx_graph, ctx_intent, ctx_session, ctx_task, ctx_cost, and 42 more. Intent-aware compression, session memory, context routing, multi-agent handoffs, knowledge graphs.

    lean-ctx setup

    $ lean-ctx setup

    Zero manual config

    How Setup Works

    1

    Detects your shell

    Finds zsh, bash, or fish and installs the shell hook that intercepts CLI commands.

    2

    Finds AI tools

    Scans for Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, and others. Configures MCP for each.

    3

    Writes MCP config

    Creates the correct JSON config for each tool. No manual editing required.

    Built on an Open Standard

    MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard for connecting AI tools to external capabilities. Any future tool that supports MCP will work with lean-ctx automatically — no updates needed.

    One binary. One protocol. Every AI tool.

    Works with your tools. Today.

    One install, one lean-ctx setup, and every AI tool you use starts saving tokens. No per-tool configuration.
